children: UK subsea tech provider's H1 revenue rose 1.1% yr/yr amid challenging market conditions
Adjusted EBITA and adjusted EPS declined due to revenue mix and higher depreciation
Company acquired Seadraulics in June, strengthening ROV tooling and expanding in Australia
Company maintains full-year 2026 outlook as stated in 20 August 2026 trading update
Ashtead Technology expects near-term headwinds from Middle East conflict and project delays
Company projects addressable market to grow at 6% CAGR, reaching $3.4 bln by 2029
REGIONAL PERFORMANCE - Solid results in Europe offset by reduced activity in the Middle East from conflict and project delays in Asia
REVENUE MIX AND DEPRECIATION - Adjusted EBITA margin impacted by changes in revenue mix and higher depreciation from strategic capex investment
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 9 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the business support services peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Ashtead Technology Holdings PLC is GBp600.00, about 73.7% above its August 28 closing price of GBp345.50
The stock recently traded at 7 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 9 three months ago
